Comment: Order processing workflow: validate -> fraud check -> parallel(payment, inventory) -> notify, with saga compensation on failure. Deploy with: aws stepfunctions create-state-machine --name order-workflow --definition file://order-workflow.asl.json --role-arn <execution-role-arn>

RefundPayment.Comment: Saga compensation: undo the charge before failing the branch.

ReleaseInventory.Comment: Saga compensation: release the stock reservation.

ChargeAndReserve.Comment: Payment and inventory have no dependency on each other, so they run concurrently.

CheckFraudScore.Comment: Branch on data, not on exceptions: high fraud scores never touch payment.

CompensateOrder.Comment: Saga compensation at workflow level: undo any branch that already completed.

NotifyCustomer.Comment: Idempotent task: safe to retry, publishes to the SNS order-events topic.

OrderFailed.Cause: Order could not be completed; compensation executed.

OrderRejected.Cause: Fraud score above threshold; order rejected before payment.

SendToDLQ.Comment: Optimized SQS integration: no Lambda needed to park a poison message.

ValidateOrder.Comment: Validates payload shape, SKU existence, and writes a PENDING row to DynamoDB.
